pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless the initial trade has moved at least +$10 in profit and trailing stop is locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require dynamic ATR buffer of at least 1.5x on initial stop-loss placement to prevent premature micro-wick termination.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$15.00, trail remainder dynamically to capture structural runs up to +$30.00.
